additional_concerns: node.ad3ed6f7c586444ec7213491 adds the scope restriction "[the fact nav] is strictly greater than [integer value 0]" without source support; this also blocks an applicable SFC designation when NAV is missing or nonpositive, although the retained source imposes no such designation condition.

The source does not supply an exposure valuation or aggregation methodology; supplied threshold classifications and numerical exposure inputs therefore remain unresolved dependencies rather than implemented measurement rules.

The candidates' UNKNOWN and CONFLICT handling are implementation conventions, not requirements established by the circular; an unavailable classification result must not be interpreted as permission to distribute without applicable requirements.

All candidates implement classification only; their declared TRUE_IS_SATISFIED convention cannot establish satisfaction of the downstream sale, distributor-selection, review or document-update requirements.
